answer.text:
You can find several quality lightweight wireless gaming mice under ₹2000 in India, such as the EvoFox Phantom Air, daWg Slay 50, and Logitech G304, all offering excellent performance with low weight for comfortable gaming sessions.
Top Picks
1. EvoFox Phantom Air Wireless Gaming Mouse
Ultra-lightweight design at 69g
Tri-mode connectivity: Bluetooth + 2.4GHz + Wired
High-precision 12,800 DPI, 1000Hz polling rate
RGB lighting and 6 programmable buttons
Rechargeable with long usage time 2
2. daWg Slay 50 Wireless Gaming Mouse
Lightweight 65g, PixArt 3311 sensor
12,000 DPI, 1000Hz polling rate
80-hour battery backup and RGB lighting with a charging dock
6 programmable buttons, high-precision 35G acceleration 2
3. Logitech G304 Lightspeed Wireless
Compact and ergonomic lightweight design (~99g)
HERO optical sensor up to 12,000 DPI for precise tracking
6 programmable buttons, onboard memory
Reliable Logitech Lightspeed wireless connectivity suitable for esports 1
4. Cosmic Byte Ignis Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Mouse
Ultra-lightweight 54g, PixArt 3311 sensor
12,000 DPI, 1000Hz polling rate
Tri-mode wireless: Bluetooth + 2.4GHz + Wired
RGB lighting and software support for button customization 2
5. Redragon M612AK PRO
Hybrid wired/wireless functionality with 8 programmable buttons
8000 DPI, RGB lighting with customizable effects
Ergonomic design for long gaming sessions 2
Buying Tips
Weight: For fast gaming reactions, aim for mice below 70g.
DPI and Polling Rate: Mice with DPI ≥12,000 and polling rate of 1000Hz give smoother, quicker cursor response.
Battery Life: Check whether rechargeable or AA/AAA batteries are used; rechargeable models reduce long-term cost.
Connectivity: Tri-mode (Bluetooth + 2.4G + wired) gives flexibility across devices.
Programmable Buttons & Software: Useful for macros in MMO/FPS gaming.
Ergonomics: Comfort is crucial for extended gameplay; consider grip type and hand size.
These gaming mice provide a balance between lightweight design, wireless freedom, and affordable pricing under ₹2000 suitable for competitive or casual gamers in India +1.
